name: sense_beyond_vision
about: The vision distance of the row's npc_perception is a hard edge. npc_perception 3 with no vision key -> InitPerceptionDistances 0x1028fb70 takes Inspection_Vision_Distances[3] = 440 units (vdata/system/feats.txt) into m_flSeekDistInspection +0x63b8; the admission body 0x102b4760 (slot 594) rejects a candidate whose eye-to-eye distance is > radius = stealth sight scalar (1.0 for a standing player, stealth.md) x 440, strictly, while the NPC is not in COMBAT (the 3072 prefilter is the only bound in combat). Guard at (384, -393.7) Source units facing +Y, D_HT 5; the standing player in the open straight ahead at 480 units for 8 s: nothing. Teleported to 400 units on the same line (inside 440, in the 0.7 band, so 0x102b3e00 also sets ATTACK_UNKNOWN for the plainly visible player -- no condition): OnLooked 0x1026a2c0 SEE_PLAYER 0x5a + SEE_HATE 0x43, ChooseEnemy NEW_ENEMY 0x54, SelectIdealState 0x102ad660 case 1 -> COMBAT; the pre-selector GetSchedule 0x102ae920 step 5 (state 2) consumes ATTACK_UNKNOWN (flags1 0x800000) before NEW_ENEMY and answers 0x5b SCHED_TROIKA_INVESTIGATE_UNKNOWN_ATTACK.
